steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the refrigerator or disconnect power before servicing. For live voltage checks, use proper PPE and disconnect power after measurements.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.

steps.title: Continue in service mode
steps.body: Service mode entered. Use Light key (SW2) to navigate to the step for this procedure.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Use SW2 to advance steps; SW5 toggles loads.

steps.title: Navigate to service step 21
steps.body: Use Light key (SW2) to advance until Freezer TEMP LEDs show step 21 (RC door switch). Wait at least 1 second between key presses.

steps.title: RC compartment lights
steps.body: At step 21: Door open = RC lights ON; Door closed = RC lights OFF.
steps.sourceExcerpt: At step 21: Door open = RC lights ON; Door closed = RC lights OFF.

branches.label: No / fault
branches.oemOutcome: RC lights do not respond to door — check door switch and harness.

steps.title: Replace RC door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace or adjust RC door switch.

steps.title: RC door switch verified
steps.oemOutcome: RC door switch operates in step 21.
